settings.heading: Order tires online.
settings.lede: Free shipping to any address in the continental US — or free to our Sunrise shop, where we fit them for you.

settings.title: Free shipping on every tire
settings.copy: No minimum and no freight surcharge. The price on the tire is the price that ships.

settings.title: Ships anywhere in the lower 48
settings.copy: Any street address in the continental United States — home, work, or your own installer.

settings.title: Free ship-to-store & install
settings.copy: Send the set to our Sunrise shop at no charge and book the fitting.

settings.title: Fresh, DOT-dated rubber
settings.copy: Drop-shipped rather than pulled off a shelf, so nothing has been ageing in a warehouse.

settings.title: Ship it to me
settings.copy: Your order ships straight to the address you give us — home, work, or your own installer. Shipping and delivery time are shown at checkout before you commit.

settings.title: Ship free to the shop — we'll fit them
settings.copy: Send the order to Extreme Tires in Sunrise at no charge, then book an install. Mounting, balancing, valve stems and disposal of the old set, all handled in the bay.

settings.heading: Shipped to you, or fitted by us
settings.lede: Pick at checkout. Local to South Florida? Ship-to-store is free and we fit them in the bay.

settings.title: Decode my tire size
settings.copy: Type what is on your sidewall and see every number explained, drawn to the proportions of your own tire. Compare two sizes and see what actually changes.

settings.title: Find my tires
settings.copy: Five questions about your car, your roads and your weather. You get the size and tire type that fit, and why.

settings.title: Do I need tires yet?
settings.copy: Check the tread with a coin you already have, and the age with the code on the sidewall. If they are fine, it says so.

settings.heading: Not sure what you need? Start here
settings.lede: Three tools that answer the questions that stop people buying tires online. They work whether or not you buy anything from us.

settings.title: Find your size
settings.copy: Read it off the sidewall, or use the size decoder if the numbers mean nothing to you yet.

settings.title: Pick your set
settings.copy: Price, tread life, wet grip and warranty are on every listing, so you are comparing the same things across brands.

settings.title: Choose where it lands
settings.copy: Your address anywhere in the continental US, or free to our Sunrise shop for fitting.

settings.title: We confirm before it ships
settings.copy: We check the sizes against your vehicle and call you to confirm fitment and take payment.

settings.heading: Four steps from search to installed
settings.lede: No stock sitting in a warehouse waiting to age — orders ship direct, so what turns up on your drive is fresh rubber.
